name: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
notes: FA-2 paper (arXiv 2307.08691). Key claims: ~2x speedup vs FA-1, reaching 50-73% of theoretical max FLOPs/s on A100. FA-1 reached only 25-40%. Three changes: reduced non-matmul FLOPs, parallelized across thread blocks for single head, better warp-level work distribution. Training speed up to 225 TFLOPs/s per A100 (72% MFU).
